name: Tool Executions
description: Wait for, inspect and cancel retained tool executions without repeating expensive work.

wait.description: Wait for a running tool execution without restarting it; returns progress or a bounded result preview.
wait.progressive_guidance: Wait for the existing id until completed, failed or canceled. waitMs bounds this wait only; it does not restart or cancel work.

executionId.description: Exact execution.id returned by an earlier tool call in this conversation.

waitMs.description: Wait window only. Default 10000; reaching it leaves the execution running.

jq.description: jq projection of retained tool output. Ripgrep records live at .result.files or .result.matches; e.g. .result.files | length. Counts cover retained records only; check returned sourceCoverage for incomplete scans.

maxChars.description: Text preview limit. Default 8000; paging reads the same retained JSON.

read.description: Query retained JSON with jq for filtering, counting or grouping, or page its textual representation.
read.progressive_guidance: jq queries original retained output before preview truncation. Check sourceCoverage when counting, filtering or grouping incomplete scans. Page with offsetChars and nextOffsetChars when needed.

executionId.description: Exact execution.id returned by an earlier tool call in this conversation.

jq.description: jq projection of retained tool output. Ripgrep records live at .result.files or .result.matches; e.g. .result.files | length. Counts cover retained records only; check returned sourceCoverage for incomplete scans.

maxChars.description: Text preview limit. Default 8000; paging reads the same retained JSON.

cancel.description: Cancel the original execution and observe its state after cleanup.
cancel.progressive_guidance: Cancel the original execution and observe its state after cleanup. Delivered input may already have taken effect; inspect its outcome before retrying.

executionId.description: Exact execution.id returned by an earlier tool call in this conversation.

progressive_guidance: Running means unfinished work. Reuse the execution id until completed, failed or canceled. A wait timeout is not an execution timeout. Results are retained for 15 minutes after completion and scoped to the same profile and conversation. jq queries retained output before preview truncation; check sourceCoverage when counting incomplete scans. Use this tool instead of restarting a scan, repeatedly reading a whole output artifact, or creating a shell script for aggregation.
